content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-05 (one cycle, 4 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 5 up, 0 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 3 of 3 planned. Sets: 38 (last cycle 38).
Main lifts, best set this cycle:
- Barbell Bench Press: 80 kg x 8 (last cycle 77.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.2%, 4 sets this cycle
- Barbell Back Squat: 112.5 kg x 5 (last cycle 110 kg x 5), estimated 1RM up 2.3%, 4 sets this cycle
- Barbell Row: 70 kg x 8 (last cycle 67.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 4 sets this cycle
- Romanian Deadlift: 90 kg x 8 (last cycle 87.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 4 sets this cycle
- Face Pull: 15 kg x 15 (last cycle 14 kg x 15), estimated 1RM up 7.1%, 4 sets this cycle
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): Barbell Bench Press 80 kg x 8; Barbell Back Squat 112.5 kg x 5; Barbell Row 70 kg x 8; Romanian Deadlift 90 kg x 8; Face Pull 15 kg x 15.
Sets per muscle per week (this 4-day cycle scaled to 7 days), where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for Chest, Back, Side delts, Rear delts, Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes, Biceps, Triceps; the others have no range): Chest 14.9 (last cycle 14.9), Back 19.3 (last cycle 19.3), Front delts 11.4 (last cycle 11.4), Side delts 2.6 (below the range; last cycle 2.6), Rear delts 10.5 (last cycle 10.5), Quads 10.5 (last cycle 10.5), Hamstrings 10.5 (last cycle 10.5), Glutes 17.5 (last cycle 17.5), Biceps 11.4 (last cycle 11.4), Triceps 12.3 (last cycle 12.3), Calves 1.8 (last cycle 1.8).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "Get stronger".
The user's note for this cycle (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
Rules that fired, most important first; each has one or more items:
- low_volume (priority 50). Advice: It takes addSets more sets each cycle to bring the muscle to 10 a week. Offer the options in its data for the user to choose between, as given, with their exercises and set counts; if there is only one, give it alone (an option is left out when it isn't a sensible one, not because nothing trains the muscle). Add no exercise of your own unless the note rules an option out.
    - Side delts: data {"muscle":"Side delts","options":["add Lateral Raise, a new exercise, for 5 sets each cycle"],"sets":1.5,"perWeek":2.6,"previousPerWeek":2.6,"target":10,"addSets":5}

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this cycle, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 25 words.
2. actions: one for each rule above. Each says exactly what to do next cycle about every item under its rule, naming each one as written above (every muscle, every lift), with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data; as short as covering every item allows. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's note: if it mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in English.
